name: crypto-meltdown
prompt: Create a 20-second vertical 9:16 comedy video: a crypto trader watches the market dump live and cycles through increasingly insane reaction faces. Expressions are the main source of comedy; include close-up reaction shots.
style_brief: Sarcastic Grotesque reaction-meme comedy. Face-first: >=50% close-ups/ECUs. Dirty dim trader bedroom at 3 AM (muted purple wall, purple LED strip, HODL + TO THE MOON posters, energy cans, pizza box) with thick #16110E ink outlines. Monitor inserts with a dutch tilt show the chart getting worse; each insert triggers a bigger snap reaction (rule of three, then an escalation run). Anton meme subtitles. Reaction backdrops: speed lines, burst, rage. Calm before every explosion; music cuts out before the final punchline.

cast.role: chaotic best friend on a video call, laughs at him

sets: custom trader bedroom (BM.R/BM.PA, ink outlines) + GR.BG.desk + GR.monitor with custom chart screens
custom Pip couch room (orange wall, WAGMI neon, couch, popcorn foreground)
props: GR.monitor (screens: pump +420%, dip -5%, crash -40%, crash -80%, LIQUIDATED -99.9%)

dialogue.text: Buy the dip! Buy the dip!

storyboard.visual: Vlad smug, thumbs up, chart +420% green; label 3:14 AM
Vlad fake smile, slight tremble, 'It's just a dip.'
GR.react panic + eye pop + speed-lines backdrop; comedic hold
Vlad greedy rubbing hands, 'Buy the dip!' (denial)
storyboard.text: BUY THE DIP! BUY THE DIP!

terrified -> hystericalCry -> unhingedRage, rage backdrop, camera shake

storyboard.shot: S10 Pip on a call (normal beat)
storyboard.visual: Pip on his couch holding phone, side-eye, popcorn
Vlad dead inside, 'I am the dip.' frozen hold, creep-in
Vlad psycho smile with tears + twitch, dread backdrop, meme caption HODL'D TO ZERO, 3 s hold

gags: Rule of three with the monitor: -5% (fake smile) -> -40% (panic) -> -80% (scream), then escalation run
Denial gag: 'Buy the dip!' greedy hand-rub right after the panic
Calm-before-boom: Pip's flat question and Vlad's dead-inside 'I am the dip.' in silence
Time labels 3:14 AM -> 3:15 AM: the whole meltdown took one minute
Punchline face: psycho smile through tears + meme caption + trombone

music.style: awkward 0-4.4 s, drama 4.4-13.5 s, silence for the punchline

publish._note: Publishing is intentionally not wired. Human review first.
